metadata.description: Distinct, production-ready design-language skills for websites and dashboards (RTL + LTR).

plugins.name: switchboard
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — Calm, settings-first utility UI where every option is one clear switch

plugins.name: hearth
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — Warm technical clarity — paper canvas, ink buttons, mono labels, honest tables

plugins.name: atelier
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — Gallery-grade product marketing — huge tight type, serif-italic accents, glass and motion

plugins.name: stratus
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — Persian-first enterprise platform — product mega menu, split headlines, rail + sub-nav consoles

plugins.name: ultraviolet
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — Dark-first infrastructure for AI — indigo space, violet light, glowing edges and isometric hardware

plugins.name: tier
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — Plan-driven commerce — domain search, billing toggles, savings ribbons and a tidy client area

plugins.name: datasheet
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — Engineering catalog — parametric filters, mono part numbers, LED stock dots and seven-segment readouts

plugins.name: sideload
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — Content & downloads hub — post cards, sidebar widgets, download boxes with mirrors and versions

plugins.name: shelf
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — Consumer app-store shelves — squircle icons, snap carousels, bright pills and a playful night canvas

plugins.name: broadsheet
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — Newspaper editorial — nameplate, column rules, kickers and decks, a newsroom built from typography

plugins.name: stamp
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — Playful neo-brutalism — thick ink outlines, hard shadows that press, flat sticker colors

plugins.name: raster
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — Swiss grid system — black, white, one red, giant grotesk numerals and a visible 12-column grid

plugins.name: teletype
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — Terminal-native UI — one monospace face, box-drawn panes, [ bracketed ] controls and a status bar

plugins.name: kashi
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — Persian heritage — girih stars, pointed arches, tile friezes and inscription-like titles on plaster ivory

plugins.name: ticker
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — Market workspace — hairline mosaics, monospace tabular numbers, green/red only for up and down

plugins.name: clay
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — Soft, tactile wellness — puffy clay surfaces, pastel tiles, controls pressed into the page

plugins.name: maison
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — Quiet luxury — Didone display, spaced small caps, hairlines and a great deal of ivory

plugins.name: bento
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — Modular modern — every idea in its own rounded tile on one calm grid

plugins.name: aisle
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — Modern store — big search, mega menu, coral deal rails and product cards that turn into steppers

plugins.name: syllabus
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — Online academy — navy graph-paper heroes, highlighter actions, curriculum with free previews and a real lesson player

plugins.name: brief
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — Design & build studio — wide display type, an ink stage for the work, scrolling browser frames and a client portal with pinned feedback

plugins.name: lucent
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — Liquid glass — refracting capsules over an aurora that takes its colours from what is playing

plugins.name: clinic
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — Healthcare booking — search-first hero, doctor cards with free slots, a time picker and a patient panel set in a hyperlegible face

plugins.name: linework
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — Hairline technical — a page ruled by 1px lines with crosshairs, ink as the only brand, mono labels and a developer console

plugins.name: estate
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — Property listings — stone paper, moss actions, serif prices, a list + map split with price pins and an agent panel with a lead pipeline

plugins.name: margin
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — Long-form reading — warm paper, a narrow serif column, numbered sidenotes in a wide margin, a reader's highlighter and a quiet writer studio

plugins.name: dot
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — Dot-matrix hardware — paper or black, one LED red, display type made of dots, a drawn device with a live 15×15 face and a device app with a glyph composer

plugins.name: passage
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — Travel documents as an interface — guilloche security paper, boarding-pass program cards, rubber stamps for milestones, a points check and a client portal built like a passport

plugins.name: rack
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — Servers you can almost touch — graphite rack-unit faceplates, status LEDs, glowing VFD readouts, one power-button orange and faders that build a VPS like a mixing desk

plugins.name: sprocket
plugins.description: Tastefolio design language — A social photo network made of analog film — posts as photo prints with a date imprint, reels on a sprocket strip, profiles as contact sheets with grease-pencil picks and a red-safelight darkroom mode

plugins.name: tastefolio-all
plugins.description: Every Tastefolio design-language skill in one install. Pick one style per project.
